works/taiwaneseamericanhistory-org/miles.title: 50. Covid 19 ( 武漢肺炎) :  21 Century of Calamity of Human Being(21 世紀的人類浩劫), Started from Jan. 2020 from Wu-Han ( 武漢 ), China and Spreaded Radily to  the world in March, 2020.
1. 1945 / The Ruling on Taiwan was changed from Japan to the Republic of China ( 國民黨) at the end of World War II.
10. 1965 / The spouses and children of Taiwan oversea students were allowed by the government of Taiwan to unite with their families in America.
11. 1965 / Some Taiwanese students were in a國民黨 black list and were not allowed to return to their home land.
12. 1965 / Majority of Taiwanese students decided to stay in the U. S. after obtained their advance degrees.
13. 1970 / Taiwanese American Association/U.S. was found. There are more than 60 local chapters in the U. S. joined the association.
14. 4/24/1970 / Mr.  Peter Huang 黃文雄attempted to shoot Mr. Chin-Kong Chiang 蔣經國in New York City.
15. 1970 / The first summer conference for Taiwanese American in East Coast.
16. 9/29/1970 / Prof. Peng Ming-Min arrived at Detroit, MI.
17. 1971 / The Movement of Self Determination by Taiwanese 台灣人民自決運動 was started.
18. 10/25/1971 / Republic of China in Taiwan was completely expelled from United Nations.
19. 2/21/1972 / President Richard Nixon visited China and issued a Shanghai Communique with Communist China.
2. 1947 / 228 Incident happened in Taiwan.  國民黨 imposed Martial Law in Taiwan.
20. 1979 / President Jimmy Carter recognized  People Republic of China (PRC) and severed diplomatic relations with  Republic of China in Taiwan.
21. 4/10/1979/Taiwan Relations Act was signed by President James Earl Carter, Jr
22. 7/3/1981 / Prof. Chen Wen Chen 陳文成教授 was found dead in Tai-da 台大（National Taiwan  University）campus in Taiwan.
23. 7/31/1981 / Taiwan Tribune 台灣公論報issued its first issue ( 創刊號)

24. 1/1/1982 / 20,000 immigration quota annually was given to the people from Taiwan. Thus, it open the gate for non-student Taiwanese immigrants to the U. S. through their direct relatives and other emigration channels.
25. 1982 / Formosan Association for Public Affair was established in Los Angeles.
26. 5/31/1983 / Taiwanese American is officially recognized as an ethnic minority group in America
27. 1985/06 / First Taiwanese school established in Houston(第一間在美國的台灣學校由十多位在休士頓地區熱心教育的台美人設立).
28. 5/24/1986 / Fund Raising party  for Senator Edward Kennedy in Los Angel  for 1986 presidential election.
29. 7/19/1986 / First Taiwan Center was established in Flushing, New York.
3. 1949 / Dr. Or Hsieh ( 謝娥醫師) arrived in America and later obtained her citizenship. She is considered to be the first Taiwanese American.
30. 9/28/1986 / Democratic Progress Party in Taiwan is established.
31. 10/15/1986 / Dr. Yuan-Tseh Lee 李遠哲博士received the Nobel Prize in Chemistry. The First T.A. received this award.
32. 12/26/1986 / T. A. participated in the first public parade of  the Immigration Festival in Queens , N.Y.
33. 1/8/1987 / T. A. started a project for Census 1990, asking T.A. to be listed as a minority ethnic group in  1990 Census  survey.
34. 2/28/1987 / First open memorial service for 228 event  ( 40th Anniversary) in America by T. A. organizations in the U. S.
35. 10/31/1987 / Democratic Torch Marathon  (民主聖火長跑) started from New York City.
36. 1/13/1988 / Mr. Lee Teng-Hui  李登輝assumed the Presidency of the Republic of China. The first Taiwanese to be the president after the death of President  Ching-Kuo Chiang.
37. 1990 / The number of names in the  black list by Taiwan government was reduced. Some T. A. returned to Taiwan for pursuing their new career.
38. 10/20/1991 / UFI （United Formosans for Independence）台獨聯盟 / Successfully moved its main operation from the U. S. to Taiwan and set up a headquarter in Taiwan
39. 1999 / Second week of May every year is Taiwanese American Heritage Week
4. 1950 / Massive refugees ( more than 2 millions) fled from China to Taiwan.
40. 2000 / Mr. Chen, Shui-bian  陳水扁was elected to be the President of Republic of China by a majority of Taiwan voters in a presidential election.
41. 2000 / The first generation of T. A. started to reached their retirement ages.
42. 09/11/2001 / 911 Attack by Middle East Terrorists on NY Twin Towers, Pentagon and White House with flying airplanes
43. 2003 / Taiwanese American Community Scholarship project in various locations of America started its operation.
44. 2005 / A number of T. A. Senior Associations were established in America.
45. 2005 / Senior T. A. started to move to new locations, which are close to  their children and with warm weather.
46. 2010 / Laguna Wood Village in S. CA becomes a popular and famous retirement place for senior T. A. in America.
47. 05/2013 / The first website of History of Taiwanese Americans started its operation.
48. 2/1/2014 / The First T. A. Archives Center in Irvine, CA started its operation.
49. 1/16/2016 / Democratic Progressive Party won the presidential and Legislative election in Taiwan. Dr. Tsai Ing-Wen is the first female President of Taiwan.
5. 1950 / College graduates departed from Taiwan to America for graduate studies.
6. 1952 – 1954 / High school graduates were allowed to go abroad for their college education.
7. 1955 / Only college graduates were allowed to go out of Taiwan for advance study. Male students had to complete their military service first.
8. 1/1/1956 / 3F (Formosans’ Free Formosa) was established in Philadelphia.

9. 1960 / U. S. government emphasized the science and engineering fields. Financial aids to the graduate students of these fields were offered by many American universities. This created graduate study opportunities for Taiwanese graduates majoring in science and engineering fields.
